title: SwarmSpec
description: Off-chain mirror of the on-chain SwarmSpec struct for tooling. The on-chain identifier is specHash = keccak256(abi.encode(spec)); this document is a convenience view and never a substitute for the struct. Field order follows the struct.

roleId.description: Unique within the spec. keccak256 of a dotted name by convention; sai.role.* names are reserved conventions, sai.role.initiator is the initiator's role when the spec has one

roleName.description: Informative; roleId SHOULD equal keccak256 of this name

min.description: Active members required for activation; 0 = none

eligibility.description: IEligibility module consulted at admission and on challenge; zero = none

selfJoin.description: May an eligible account join without the ADMIT authority during an OPEN phase

name.description: Label (a short string left-aligned in bytes32)

payoff.description: A registered term under keccak256("sai.dimension.payoff"). Base terms: keccak256 of sai.payoff.shared | sai.payoff.exclusive | sai.payoff.mixed

topology.description: A registered term under keccak256("sai.dimension.topology"). Base terms: keccak256 of sai.topology.redundant | partitioned | sequential | hierarchical | iterative | free

coordination.description: A registered term under keccak256("sai.dimension.coordination"). Base terms: keccak256 of sai.coordination.leader | collective | market | automated | none

payoffName.description: Informative; the dotted name whose keccak256 is payoff

topologyName.description: Informative; the dotted name whose keccak256 is topology

coordinationName.description: Informative; the dotted name whose keccak256 is coordination

inputWindow.description: Seconds from phase start during which admissions and contributions are accepted; 0 = unbounded

descriptorHash.description: Informative; SHA-256 of the JCS form of the phase descriptor in the Swarm Pack, or zero

authorities.description: Indexed by DecisionPoint: ACTIVATE, ABORT, SUSPEND, RESUME, ADVANCE, CONCLUDE, DISSOLVE, SUCCEED, ADMIT, REMOVE, REINSTATE, AMEND, ATTACH, DETACH, SET_ACCOUNT, REPRESENT

target.description: ADDRESS: the holder at formation; otherwise zero

contributions.description: Who may record contributions: nobody, active and suspended members, or anyone (non-member records are flagged)

recruitmentWindow.description: Seconds after formation (and after a phase start in a RECRUIT phase) before anyone may enforce the roster; MUST be > 0

maxDuration.description: Hard cap from activation; 0 = none. At least one of maxDuration and inactivityTimeout MUST be > 0

inactivityTimeout.description: Anyone may suspend, then conclude, after this much inactivity; 0 = disabled

ineligibleGrace.description: After this long in SUSPENDED(INELIGIBLE), anyone may expel

settlementWindow.description: After this long in CONCLUDING, anyone may dissolve

amendmentExitWindow.description: Members may leave without consequence for this long after a material amendment

descriptorHash.description: Informative; SHA-256 of the JCS form of the spec description in the Swarm Pack, or zero
